India Secures Multiple Gold Medals in Commonwealth Games 2026

Indian athletes achieved significant success at the Commonwealth Games 2026, with boxers winning a record seven gold medals. Judoka Asmita Dey secured a gold medal, with her father being a cycle mechanic. Boxer Sachin Siwach, who won gold in the men's 60 kg final, expressed the unique happiness of seeing the national flag raised. Additionally, India achieved a historic victory in the Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships 2026, securing six gold and four silver medals.
